# Dashboard renders blank on Safari after frontend deploy

Safari users see a blank white page on the dashboard; Chrome and Firefox work fine.

A build config change set the Babel target too high, so optional-chaining syntax shipped untranspiled and crashed on older Safari engines.

1. Reproduce on the affected Safari version and capture the SyntaxError
2. Restore the browserslist target to include the supported Safari range
3. Rebuild and verify the bundle transpiles optional chaining
4. Add a cross-browser smoke test to the pipeline

Error Details
```
Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected token '?'; console: optional chaining not supported; bundle used ?. without transpilation target for older Safari
```

Tags: frontend, safari, syntaxerror, transpilation, optional-chaining
